# truenas_app_registry (Data Source)

Looks up a TrueNAS app container registry entry by name. Never exposes the registry password: this datasource has no "password" attribute.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the container registry to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the container registry.
- `id` (Number) Numeric app registry entry ID assigned by TrueNAS.
- `uri` (String) Container registry URI endpoint.
- `username` (String) Username for registry authentication.
